title: The attacker zoo (W1, out-of-model in red)
caption: Attacker zoo. Left, game W1 only (one note, exact projective verifier, no oracle): grey bars are the exact per-qubit both-pass probabilities re-computed from each attack's Kraus operators (qmint.attacks.heuristic) and checked against the closed forms shown; blue points are lane C Monte Carlo estimates at n=1 (Clopper-Pearson 95%). Measure-resend reaches 5/8, not 3/4. No in-model attack exceeds the MVW optimum 3/4. Right, red: attacks that break a W1 hypothesis (A06 runs on a toy lossy threshold verifier, game W2, NO_THEOREM; A08 uses a leaky accept/reject oracle; CTRL is given the secret basis). They are OUT_OF_MODEL and are NOT counterexamples to MVW Theorem 1; ticks show (3/4)^n for the same n for contrast only.
legend: [MC] Monte Carlo n=1, 10^4 notes, 95% CP (lower bound on worst case)
[THEOREM] W1 optimum 3/4 over ALL channels (MVW Thm 1)
[THEOREM] exact per-qubit both-pass value of the attack (closed form in label)
[OUT-OF-MODEL] breaks a W1 hypothesis: NOT a counterexample to Thm 1
[THEOREM] (3/4)^n for the same n, contrast only
